understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' was simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece, triggering a WIN for the level and ultimately for the full run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn-based with a limited step budget per level. Actions were directional moves and CLICKs on specific grid coordinates; CLICK either selected/switched the active controllable piece or attempted to move the selected piece to the clicked target if the rules allowed. Pieces could not pass through walls/obstacles and would fail to move if blocked (as seen by repeated clicks on blocked coordinates). Winning required correct placement of all selectable pieces onto goal tiles at the same time before steps ran out.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' was simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece, triggering a WIN for the level and ultimately for the full run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn-based with a limited step budget per level. Actions were directional moves and CLICKs on specific grid coordinates; CLICK either selected/switched the active controllable piece or attempted to move the selected piece to the clicked target if the rules allowed. Pieces could not pass through walls/obstacles and would fail to move if blocked (as seen by repeated clicks on blocked coordinates). Winning required correct placement of all selectable pieces onto goal tiles at the same time before steps ran out.
